calibration.follows: Per-type P(substantive | reached) from substantiveness_by_hearing_type.csv and failure-reason shares from hearing_failure_reasons.csv, fitted on training seeds 1 to 20 under the status quo.
conflicts: JUDGEMENT is marked 100% substantive (estimated) while the reference table records 3.58 hearings per case and the failure table 4 non-substantive judgement hearings. The calibration keeps pronouncement substantive and lets adjournments before pronouncement happen at the failure table's rate.
APPLICATION_REVIEW is marked 85% substantive (estimated) with 1.0 hearings per case; the calibration follows the 85%.
